steps.text: Put 2-element repeating number pattern on board, e.g., 3, 3, 6; 3, 3, 6; 3, 3, … …

lessons.title: Addition Story Problems: Sum After Having More
lessons.objectives_intro: By the end of the lesson the learner should be able to:
objectives: Write addition story problems: sum after having more.

activities.title: Addition Story Problems: Sum After Having More
activities.title_nl: Liggéeyi jukki ci ay kàddu boole; ganaaw bu ame lim yu ci yokku/tege.

steps.text: Present pupils with addition problems involving having more to solve. Ci misaal;
1. Awa dafa amoon 5 woññeekaay ci kow taabulam bi. Su ci yokke yeneen 2, ñaata lay am ci kow taabulam bi?
2. Buba am na 6 woññeekaay ci kow taabulam bi. Jàngalekaat bi ne ko dafa war a am 8, waay 6 rek la am. Ñaata la ci war a yokka ngir am 8?
Write corresponding addition statements on board (i.e., 5 + 2 = __; 6 + __ = 8) and help pupils see the connection between the situation and the statement and find the answer.
Give pupils more examples to solve, and for each,
Bindaleen kàddu boole ak kàddu wáññi yii ci seen bindukaay yi, te ngeen jekkalileen ak seeni woññeekaay yi. Leeraleen, ni ngeen ame tontu wi”. Have pupils do G1PB Activity 1.9.1.

closure.assessment: Have learners listen and solve the word problems: a. Amie had 3 counters on her desk. if she adds 1 more counter, how many will she have on her desk? b. Musa has 5 counters on his desk. The teacher says he needs to have 7, but he has only 5. how many more counters does he need to have 7?

lessons.title: Subtraction: comparing to find “How Many More”?
lessons.objectives_intro: By the end of the lesson the learner should be able to:
objectives: do Subtraction by comparing to find “how many more”

activities.title: Subtraction: Comparing to Find “How Many More”?
activities.title_nl: Wàññi: Di méngale ngir ut ñaata moo ci yokku?

steps.text: Present pupils with problems involving comparing, E.g.,
Ci misaal;
1. Awa dafa amoon 9 pensil. Buba am 6. Kan moo óppale? Ñaata la óppalee?
2. Awa óppalee na Buba 3 pensil. Su Awa amee 7 pensil, kon ñaata la Buba am?
Write corresponding subtraction statement on board (i.e., 8 − 6 = __); 5 − 3 = __) so and help pupils see the connection between the situation and the statement and find the answer.
Give pupils more examples to solve, and for each,
Bindaleen kàddu wàññi yi ci seen bindukaay yi. Jekkalileen ko di jëfoo seen woññeekaay yi ak pexeem méngale te ngeen leeral seen tontu wi.. Have pupils do G1PB Activity 1.9.2.

closure.assessment: Have learners listen and solve the word problems: a. Haja had 7 pencils. Musa has 5. Ho has more? How many more? b. Amie has 3 more pencils than Musa. If Amie has 8 pencils, how many pencils does Musa have?
closure.homework: Ask learners to create a problem that involves comparison of two numbers to find which has more and how many more.
